pullRequests.title: Make the build and try tools run natively on Windows
pullRequests.author: chistianh
pullRequests.head: windows-native
pullRequests.body:
The README says Windows works natively with Git Bash (bash tools/build.sh), but on a plain Windows install every compile failed:

cc.sh, build_libgcc.sh, build_libm.sh, compile_variants.sh and try_variants.py always call wine, which does not exist on Windows (the 32-bit compilers run directly there).
try_func.py writes Path.relative_to() into compile.sh, which gives backslashes on Windows; bash reads them as escapes, so the compile never runs (it reported COMPILE failed for every candidate, and…
